title: Site Reliability Engineer (Remote)(Located in the United Kingdom)
description:
KnowBe4 empowers the modern workforce to make smarter security decisions every day. Trusted by more than 70,000 organizations worldwide, KnowBe4 is the pioneer of digital workforce security, securing both AI agents and humans. The KnowBe4 Platform provides attack simulation and training, collaboration security, and agent security powered by AIDA (Artificial Intelligence Defense Agents) and a proprietary Risk Score. The platform leverages 15-years of behavioral data to combat advanced threats including social engineering, prompt injection, and shadow AI. By securing humans and agents, KnowBe4 leads the industry in workforce trust and defense.

To learn more about our team and office culture in England (UK), visit the following links.
Careers Page: https://www.knowbe4.com/careers/locations/york
Glassdoor: https://www.glassdoor.com/Location/KnowBe4-York-Location-EI_IE969384.0,7_IL.8,12_IC3297365.htm
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/knowbe4/life/uk/

KnowBe4’s Site Reliability Engineers help ensure that our platforms are reliable, secure, scalable, and efficient. They work alongside other engineers in a fast-paced, agile development environment, and share solutions to advance the technologies running our systems, improve their safety and reliability, and make the complex distributed services that deliver our platforms easy to understand.

The ideal member of our team gets excited about new AWS service releases, stays up-to-date on industry trends and design patterns, and has excellent time-management and communication skills.

Some of the technologies we use:

  • Programming Languages - Python, Ruby, Rust
  • Infrastructure as Code - Terraform, AWS, OpenTofu
  • Source Code Management and CI/CD - GitLab, Git
  • Observability - DataDog
  • Containerized Workloads - Docker
  • Cloud-native infrastructure in AWS - ECS, Lambda, Step Functions, SNS/SQS, Transit Gateway, Aurora, DynamoDB, CloudFront, S3, AppSync, API Gateway, and many more.

Responsibilities:

  • Identify and plan future prevention for production incidents
  • Design globally distributed systems and processes for the organization
  • Identify deficiencies in our current applications and infrastructure and correct them when found
  • Define tailored solutions to complex technical problems and effectively share them with your teammates
  • Makes significant new contributions in technology, sometimes resulting in patents, trade secrets, and/or professional publications and presentations
  • Translates KnowBe4's strategic goals into operational plans
  • Provides coordination across functional boundaries.
  • May act as team lead for larger sub-projects or entire, small projects

Minimum Qualifications:

  • BS/MS/Ph.D. or equivalent plus 3 years experience
  • Training in secure coding practices (preferred)
  • Proficient coding in multiple or unfamiliar programming languages (e.g. Python, Ruby, Javascript).
  • Experience architecting intricate, high-scale patterns in AWS
  • Experience architecting repeatable workflows for continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) - GitLab is preferred
  • Superb communication and documentation skills
  • Effectively able to self-manage your time across competing projects
  • Ability to quickly understand, debug, and explain complex distributed systems
  • AWS Cloud Certification(s) - Associate Level

Additional Qualifications (Preferred):

  • AWS Cloud Certification(s) - Professional Level
  • GCP and or Azure
  • Experience working for a public company
  • Open-source contributions or technical blog experience

Our Fantastic Benefits

We offer company-wide bonuses based on monthly sales targets, employee referral bonuses, adoption assistance, tuition reimbursement, certification reimbursement, and certification completion bonuses - all in a modern, high-tech, and fun work environment. For more details about our benefits in each office location, please visit www.knowbe4.com/careers/benefits.

Note: An applicant assessment and background check may be part of your hiring procedure.

Individuals seeking employment at KnowBe4 are considered without prejudice to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law. If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please visit www.knowbe4.com/careers/request-accommodation.

No recruitment agencies, please.

title: Research Engineer Privacy and Anonymization
description:
Location: San Francisco or Singapore (on-site), or remote (Singapore or US Pacific time zones)
Start Date: ASAP
Languages: English
Team: Engineering

About the Role

Our client is a fast-growing AI company building reliable, fair and open infrastructure for AI training data. Their marketplace helps the people who create data get value for it, and gives AI labs trustworthy data to train on. It is already used by startups, Fortune 500 companies and frontier labs, and the company is backed by leading venture investors, including Y Combinator. They are scaling quickly to meet strong demand.

We are looking for a Research Engineer, Privacy and Anonymization to build the systems that make sensitive, real-world data safe and still useful for AI training. You will develop methods to detect and remove personally identifiable information, secrets and other sensitive content from raw data before it enters processing and synthetic data pipelines â protecting privacy without destroying the structure and signal that make the data valuable for training agents.

This is a privacy and data-protection engineering seat, not a synthetic-task design role. You will own the pipeline that stands in front of downstream processing, training, evaluation and synthetic generation.

This is a full-time role, starting ASAP. Offices are in San Francisco and Singapore; remote candidates are welcome if their working hours can overlap about 70â80% with either San Francisco (US Pacific) or Singapore business hours. The exact daily schedule will be agreed during hiring.

What You'll Do

  • Build systems to detect PII, quasi-identifiers, credentials and other sensitive information, and design transformations based on the data type and the downstream use case.

  • Develop and benchmark detection approaches that combine rules, statistical models, classifiers and LLM-based methods.

  • Build production pipelines that anonymize raw data before it enters downstream processing, training, evaluation or synthetic data generation.

  • Create evaluation frameworks that measure privacy risk and retained data utility, including recall-weighted metrics, leakage tests and adversarial re-identification attempts.

  • Design systems that stay robust to new data sources, schema drift, unusual formats and sensitive information embedded in unexpected fields.

  • Work with engineering, research, operations and customers to translate privacy requirements into practical technical policies and safeguards.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong proficiency in Python, and experience building reliable production data or machine-learning systems.

  • Experience with information extraction, named-entity recognition, classification, or related methods for detecting rare or sensitive content.

  • Strong experimental instincts, and the ability to compare approaches across recall, precision, latency, cost and downstream data utility.

  • An understanding of the difference between redaction, masking, pseudonymization, anonymization and synthetic data â and when each is appropriate.

  • High attention to detail, and the ability to reason about subtle leakage paths, edge cases and adversarial failure modes.

  • Experience building data-processing pipelines end to end, including where there was no fully prescribed roadmap.

  • Clear written and spoken English, and comfort collaborating across teams and time zones.

  • Strong candidates may also have hands-on experience with privacy-enhancing technologies (such as differential privacy, k-anonymity, secure aggregation or format-preserving encryption); have worked with sensitive data in healthcare, finance or security; have built low-latency or high-throughput ML inference or data-processing systems; or have taken work from early research through to production.

  • Technical aptitude and learning potential matter more than years of experience. Motivated candidates are encouraged to apply even if they don't meet every point above.

Why This Role Matters for You

  • Make real-world data safe to train on: You will build the systems that let sensitive data be used for AI training without exposing people or secrets.

  • Privacy without wrecking utility: The job is not only to redact, but to keep the structure and signal that downstream training and synthetic pipelines need.

  • From detection to production: You will own the full path: detection methods, transformations, evaluation, and the pipeline that sits in front of training and generation.

  • Hard, high-stakes edge cases: Work on leakage paths, schema drift and adversarial failure modes, not only clean benchmark datasets.

  • San Francisco, Singapore, or remote: Work on-site in San Francisco or Singapore, or remotely, with hours that overlap about 70â80% with either US Pacific or Singapore business hours. The exact daily schedule will be agreed during hiring.

title: Pflichtpraktikum im Bereich Tech (m/w/d)
description:
Wir sind PsyCurio, ein HealthTech-Startup, das Psychotherapie mit Virtual Reality neu denkt. Wir bauen eine VR-gestützte Therapie-Infrastruktur, die Therapeut:innen im klinischen Alltag entlastet und Patient:innen Zugang zu strukturierten, wirksamen und modernen Übungen ermöglicht, etwa bei Angststörungen, Suchterkrankungen oder anderen psychischen Belastungen.

Unser Ziel ist klar: Psychotherapeutische Versorgung soll zugänglicher, messbarer und skalierbarer werden. Für Patient:innen, für Therapeut:innen und für ein Gesundheitssystem, das neue Lösungen braucht, statt nur längere Wartelisten zu verwalten.

Du arbeitest bei uns an der Schnittstelle von Technik, Psychologie, MedTech und Virtual Reality. Dabei unterstützt du uns bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer VR-Anwendungen, beim Testen und Optimieren unserer Software und Hardware, bei KI-Experimenten und der Evaluation neuer VR-Technologien sowie bei der Frage, wie digitale Therapie technisch zuverlässig und sinnvoll in den klinischen Alltag integriert werden kann. Du bist nicht nur dabei, sondern arbeitest aktiv an Themen mit, die für Therapeut:innen und Patient:innen einen echten Unterschied machen können.

Tasks

Je nach aktuellen Projekten unterstützt du uns unter anderem bei:

  • der Weiterentwicklung und Anpassung unserer VR-Szenarien in Unity: Du setzt kleinere Features um und behebst Bugs

  • Software Testing & QA: Du testest Szenarien, dokumentierst Bugs und führst Regressionstests durch

  • der Einrichtung und Pflege unserer VR-Hardware: Du setzt Headsets auf, installierst und aktualisierst Software und prüfst, ob alles zuverlässig läuft

  • technischer Dokumentation: Du pflegst Anleitungen, Testprotokolle und Entwicklerdokumentation, damit Wissen im Team nicht verloren geht

  • der Integration und Optimierung von 3D-Assets sowie einfachen Animationen

  • KI-Experimenten: Du evaluierst KI-Tools für 360°-Umgebungen und VR-Inhalte und baust erste Prototypen

  • Performance-Analysen: Du untersuchst Framerate, Ladezeiten und Standalone-Performance

  • Automatisierung: Du schreibst kleine Skripte für Tests und wiederkehrende Prozesse

  • technischem Support: Du reproduzierst Probleme und analysierst technische Fehler

  • Recherchen zu neuen VR-Technologien, Unity-Tools und Integrationen

  • Themen, die im Hintergrund wichtig sind und für die Weiterentwicklung unserer Technologie einen echten Unterschied machen

Requirements

  • Du studierst Informatik, Medieninformatik, Game Development, Software Engineering oder ein vergleichbares Fach

  • Du suchst ein Pflichtpraktikum, bei dem du nicht nur zuschaust, sondern wirklich mitarbeitest

  • Du bringst Programmiergrundlagen in mindestens einer Sprache mit, idealerweise C#

  • Softwareentwicklung, Virtual Reality, DeepTech/ DeepMind und XR findest du spannend

  • Du denkst mit, stellst gute Fragen und möchtest Dinge verstehen und verbessern

  • Struktur, Eigeninitiative und Zuverlässigkeit sind für dich selbstverständlich und du gehst Probleme lösungsorientiert an

  • Du würdest gern in einem kleinen, interdisziplinären Team aus Tech, Psychologie und Forschung arbeiten

  • Deutsch und Englisch sind für dich kein Problem, auch für technische Dokumentation

  • Du hast schon erste Erfahrungen mit VR Entwicklung gesammelt

  • Erfahrung mit Unity und C#, Meta Quest/OpenXR, Blender oder anderen 3D-Tools, Git, Python, Debugging und Softwaretests oder generativer KI/LLMs ist wünschenswert. Auch Interesse an Digital Health und Psychologie freut uns

  • Dein Lebenslauf muss nicht perfekt sein. Viel wichtiger sind Neugier, Eigeninitiative und echtes Interesse

Benefits

Bei PsyCurio tauchst du tief in die Welt eines HealthTech-Startups ein, das Psychologie, Virtual Reality, Forschung und MedTech zusammenbringt. Du arbeitest an Themen mit direkter Relevanz für die psychotherapeutische Versorgung und bekommst Einblick in Produktentwicklung, wissenschaftliche Fragestellungen und kliniknahe Anwendungen.

Das Praktikum ist unvergütet. Dafür erlebst du das rasante Tempo eines Startups, übernimmst von Anfang an Verantwortung und bringst deine eigenen Ideen ein. Die Wege sind kurz, der Austausch ist direkt und du sitzt nicht nur in Meetings, sondern bewegst wirklich etwas.

Du arbeitest bei uns vollständig remote und kannst das Praktikum in Vollzeit für bis zu drei Monate oder entsprechend länger in Teilzeit absolvieren. Abschluss- oder Projektarbeiten sind nach Absprache ebenfalls möglich. Wenn es für beide Seiten passt, sprechen wir gern über eine weitere Zusammenarbeit, zum Beispiel als Werkstudent:in.

Klingt spannend? Dann erzähl uns, warum du Lust hast, bei PsyCurio dabei zu sein, was dich an Virtual Reality, MedTech oder digitaler Gesundheit fasziniert und wie du unser Team unterstützen kannst. Schick uns gern Links zu deinem Portfolio, deinem GitHub-Profil oder einem VR-Projekt, auf das du stolz bist.

title: Platform Deployment Engineer (Europe)
description:
Neural Concept embeds AI into design and simulation workflows so engineering teams make continuous, data-driven decisions instead of waiting on sequential design–simulation–validation cycles. None of that matters until the platform is running inside the customer's environment, on their infrastructure, under their rules.


That is this role. You take an enterprise customer and make the platform real for them: architected, deployed, integrated, cleared by their security organisation, and stable enough that their engineers stop thinking about it. You own that outcome end to end for named accounts, as their primary technical counterpart.

 

What you will do

  • The deployment, from the first architecture conversation through go-live and into steady-state operation.

  • Its integration with the customer's identity, data and engineering systems, and the infrastructure and model serving layer beneath it.

  • The relationship with their IT, security and platform teams: assessments, architecture reviews, and the call when something breaks.

  • The diagnosis when it does break, including when the cause sits outside our own software.

  • The runbooks, post-mortems and playbooks that make the next deployment easier, and the feedback loop into Product.

 

Where you will do it
Managed Kubernetes across the major clouds. On-premises and fully air-gapped clusters with no route to the internet, GPU infrastructure, self-hosted model serving. Customer HPC environments, schedulers, and shared storage under real load.

 

If installing software with no internet access, on hardware you do not control, reads as the interesting part of the job rather than the obstacle, this will suit you.

 

Who you are

You will often be the only Neural Concept engineer in the room. We are looking for someone with:

  • 6+ years deploying and operating enterprise software in production, two of them in environments you did not control.

  • Kubernetes at configuration depth: how chart values become rendered manifests, and why a workload will not start.

  • Identity and SSO fundamentals: OIDC and SAML, clients and credential rotation, redirect URIs, group-to-role mapping.

  • Linux, networking and TLS: DNS, routing, ingress and egress, certificate chains and interception proxies.

  • Kubernetes storage: persistent volumes and CSI, access modes, diagnosing shared storage that degrades under load.

  • Professional customer-facing English, and willingness to travel and work your customers' hours.

Also valuable: regulated or air-gapped deployments · private registries and image mirroring · GPU scheduling and LLM serving · enterprise IdP administration · Terraform and GitOps · Prometheus and Grafana · HPC schedulers · ISO 27001 evidence · Python · PLM, CAD or CAE exposure.

 

You Get

  • Work with a world-class technology team – our engineers are top-notch, and we always aim for excellence.

  • Benefit from a competitive salary and rewarding opportunities as we continue to scale.

  • Thrive in a collaborative, multicultural environment where your work is visible and recognized.

  • Develop professionally alongside talented colleagues who share knowledge freely and support one another.

  • Make a global impact by helping customers shift to AI-assisted design, making innovation faster, smarter, and more sustainable.

  • Balance life and work with remote work or hybrid model (20% remote) —we care about results, not rigid schedules.

 

Where You Will Be

  • Remote from Europe or one of our offices in Switzerland or Munich;

  • Travelling: This position will require travelling to customer location within Europe

  • Start date: ASAP

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and we're committed to building a diverse and inclusive environment where you can thrive.

title: Data Platform Engineer
description:
About the role

At ClickHouse, we believe in making product decisions grounded in data, not gut feelings. To support that, we've built a comprehensive internal data warehouse — read more about it on our blog. It powers analytics, forecasting, and decision-making across every team in the company.

Our stack centers on ClickHouse as the core storage and processing engine, complemented by dbt, Airflow, S3, AWS, Superset, and GitHub Actions. We ingest data from 30+ distinct external sources, process over 2.5 PB of data, and deliver most data marts to business consumers with a 1-hour end-to-end latency - a standard that demands highly optimized, rock-solid transformation pipelines.

We're looking for a Senior Data Engineer to help evolve the DWH platform, push its technical boundaries, and deliver reliable, high-performance data models to business users across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

  1. DWH Platform Development

    • Design and develop reusable Airflow components - operators, connectors, and hooks - along with custom integrations tailored to our data architecture.

    • Build reusable dbt macros and abstractions: incremental strategies, ETL building blocks, and generic data quality tests, all optimized for ClickHouse-specific behavior and our data patterns.

    • Develop DataOps tooling - CI pipelines, data migration frameworks, and security controls - with a strong focus on reliability, self-service usability, and scale.

  2. Team contributions

    • Conduct thorough code reviews for team members and other team contributors.

    • Actively participate in technical and architectural design discussions.

    • Drive technical leadership in specific areas of our stack.

    • Continuously improve the team's development environment, with a focus on automation - including AI-assisted workflows.

    • Contribute to platform stability through proactive troubleshooting and timely incident resolution.

  3. Data modeling

    • Develop, refactor, and optimize business data models in line with our modeling standards and ClickHouse best practices.

    • Mentor and support contributors through code reviews and technical guidance.

    • Lead the design and implementation of the most technically demanding data marts - particularly those involving high data velocity, large volumes, or complex business logic.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Exceptional SQL skills - this is non-negotiable.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Airflow, dbt, and Python.

  • Proven track record building and optimizing large-scale, high-throughput data pipelines.

  • Solid understanding of data warehousing fundamentals: ETL/ELT, dimensional modeling, and data quality.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field.

  • Comfortable thriving in a fast-paced startup environment — exciting and dynamic, but sometimes wonderfully chaotic.

Preferred:

  • Hands-on experience with ClickHouse - a significant advantage.

  • Familiarity with AWS or other cloud platforms.

  • Experience with CI/CD development, especially using GitHub Actions.

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new eligible team member who joins our company receives equity.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

title: Application Security Engineer
description:
Role Description

As part of the Product Security Engineering team, you’ll focus on reducing risk at scale by building the security infrastructure, automation, and tooling that empowers engineers to ship secure products with confidence. We work closely with engineering and product teams throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC), embedding secure-by-default practices and delivering scalable solutions.

Product Security Engineers create impact by implementing security tooling, writing custom security rules, and building frameworks that address broad classes of vulnerabilities. In addition to proactive development, we support teams through threat modeling, documentation, and education to uplift security culture across Dropbox.

Our Engineering Career Framework is viewable by anyone outside the company and describes what’s expected for our engineers at each of our career levels. Check out our blog post on this topic and more here.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain security tools, automation, and libraries to enable secure-by-default development across engineering teams.
  • Design and implement custom security rules (e.g., Semgrep, CodeQL) to detect and prevent common and emerging vulnerability patterns.
  • Act as a subject matter expert on application security across web, mobile, and desktop environments.
  • Improve and scale the Secure Development Lifecycle (SDLC) by integrating tools, checks, and processes into engineering workflows.
  • Perform targeted code reviews, and develop follow-up tooling or controls to prevent regressions.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, product, GRC, and AI/ML teams to proactively address security risks, especially in fast-moving and emerging tech areas.

Many teams at Dropbox run Services with on-call rotations, which entails being available for calls during both core and non-core business hours. If a team has an on-call rotation, all engineers on the team are expected to participate in the rotation as part of their employment. Applicants are encouraged to ask for more details of the rotations to which the applicant is applying.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience in application security or security engineering roles.
  • Hands-on experience building or using security automation tools to improve developer workflows and product security.
  • Demonstrated ability to work across the SDLC, including supporting and interpreting findings from penetration tests and bug bounty reports.
  • Familiarity with modern tech stacks, including microservices, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native environments.
  • Solid understanding of common vulnerability classes (e.g., injection, XSS, authN/authZ issues) and practical mitigation strategies.
  • Comfortable working in cross-functional environments and supporting multiple product and engineering teams simultaneously.
  • Experience participating in or supporting incident response or security on-call rotations is a plus

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in application security engineering, with a strong focus on security tooling and automation.
  • Demonstrated ability to write and maintain custom security rules and integrate them into developer workflows.
  • Experience with machine learning systems, particularly generative AI, and the ability to support secure development in AI-driven products.
  • Experience developing internal libraries or frameworks that reduce or eliminate entire classes of vulnerabilities.
  • Proficient in software development, with experience contributing production-level code in one or more modern languages.
  • Familiarity with securing diverse application types, including web, mobile, and native platforms.
  • Experience with data security, including tooling for data protection, access control, and encryption.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to build trusted partnerships with cross-functional teams.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve:

  • Awareness: Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment: Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.
  • Adaptability: Learn, adjust, and stay effective through change.
  • Connection: Communicate, collaborate, and build trust.

To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

title: Electrical Engineer II (Integrations)
description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

🐙 Kraken Generation Flex

The energy industry is undergoing the largest transformation since industrialisation, at an unprecedented rate of change and we are positioning ourselves at the heart of it. In the UK, with a legally binding Net Zero target for 2050 and a clean-power ambition for 2030, we are scaling rapidly to integrate Distributed Energy Resources (DERs) into the grid.

Kraken is recognised as a thought leader and innovator. With complete independence from Octopus Energy, we are building a SaaS business that digitally connects hundreds of thousands of DERs with energy markets. As our UK fleet grows and we support our expansion across Europe, we are looking for an Integrations Engineer to help turn customer sites into market-connected, controllable assets.

🏠 Where you’ll fit in and role summary

As we scale our fleet of integrated assets, we are looking for an Electrical Engineer to support the delivery of our site integrations and grow into owning them, learning the full lifecycle from the early information stage through design, deployment and testing.

You’ll be part of an engineering delivery team, based in Manchester, who take an integration project from the very early information stage, design how it will be integrated into Kraken’s platform and then turn that design into a live, controllable, market-participating asset.

Engineering delivery is an innovative and engineering-focused team with a culture that fosters collaboration and fresh thinking to create a new energy system. Alongside design, deployment and testing; they constantly look into ways to improve efficiency through tooling and the automation of repetitive tasks. They collaborate daily with delivery managers and customer success to onboard new sites as well as support the existing.

🚀 What you'll own

  • Integration design contribution: With guidance, analyse provided information and contribute to hardware and software integration approaches. When necessary, exchange information with customer technical representatives through meetings and emails, and take part in design discussions with other team members.

  • Technical judgement: Develop your technical judgement, making well-reasoned decisions and trade-offs with support from senior engineers, and contributing technical input to discussions within the team.

  • Developing domain knowledge: Build up your knowledge in one or more technical areas. This could include grid regulations (G99, G100, Grid Code etc.), energy markets, multi BMUs, industrial communication protocols, industrial networking, internet of things, cyber security and so on.

  • Gateway application & configuration: Learn how the Gateway software (developed by an internal software team) works and how it is configured. Understand the requirements for an integration and judge if the gateway software is able to support it or will need new development work. The team will help you get gateway configuration literate and you will carry out deployments and changes independently over time.

  • Hardware and Software Deployments: Learn the process of our hardware and software deployments. Over time, take ownership of the configuration, deployment and testing with guidance from the senior engineers.

  • Networking and cyber security: Contribute to hardware and network connectivity designs, keeping our own cyber security posture in mind as well as addressing the concerns from customers, with the support of the internal security team.

  • Site testing & commissioning: Carry out site testing and commissioning initially with the support of the team and building toward doing this independently as onboarding demand grows.

  • Incidents & compliance: Help address engineering help requests from other teams and support incident response in the case of issues at existing sites.

🧠 What you'll bring to the party

  • Understanding of the Regulations: Working knowledge of the UK Grid Code, G99 and the other obligations of a grid-connected asset before it can participate in the energy markets.

  • Understanding of the UK Energy Markets: Working understanding of the NESO ancillary services (Dynamic Containment / Moderation / Regulation, Firm Frequency Response), the Balancing Mechanism, and the DNO connection/integration process.

  • Technical judgement: Sound technical judgement and a structured approach to problems, working with the team to agree and implement a solution.

  • Power plant systems: Ability to read and analyse single line diagrams for a given power plant to understand the site architecture for the points of metering and control instrumentation.

  • Asset integration: Exposure to, or a keen interest in, integrating BESS (grid-scale and/or C&I) and/or RES (Wind and Solar) for telemetry and control.

  • Integration design: Ability to contribute to clear integration designs and design documentation.

  • Hardware and Networking: Familiarity with control systems deployments and their connectivity including the local networking and cyber security aspects, and an ability to help debug site connectivity and networking issues (including 4G routers and firewalls) with support.

  • Industrial Communication Protocols: Practical experience or a good working knowledge of Modbus (TCP/RTU); awareness of one or more of IEC 60870-5-104, IEC 61400-25, OPC-UA or DNP3 is a plus.

  • CAD, Diagrams and Tools: Experience or familiarity with CAD tools such as AutoCAD or BricsCAD, Miro and Notion.

  • Communication: A clear communicator who documents their work (e.g. in design docs and Notion) and collaborates well with the team.

  • Commissioning landscape: Awareness of the other parties involved in site commissioning for power plants, their roles and responsibilities, and how we work with them.

  • Engineering background: Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering, Automation/Control, Software, or a related field - or equivalent practical experience in industrial/energy integration.

  • A proactive and collaborative mindset: You are eager to learn and grow, reliable and collaborative. You take initiative, communicate openly, raise risks early, and care about safe working. You welcome feedback, support your teammates, and steadily build toward taking on more independent ownership of integrations over time.

  • Travel: Willingness to travel to customers and sites although travel is very occasional. Awareness of site safety is required as we may work with site personnel even though we are remote.

⭐️ Bonus points

  • Wider knowledge of grid compliance (G99, G100, Grid Code) and where the Kraken system fits in.

  • Experience with AWS IoT Greengrass or similar edge-deployment architectures.

  • Familiarity with software/scripting and templating (e.g. Python, Rust, the Linux command line) and Git-based workflows.

  • Understanding of IT/OT security in the energy sector (IEC 62443, NIS Regulations awareness).

  • Exposure to wider European balancing markets / ENTSO-E frameworks and TSO integrations.

title: AI Benchmark Engineer | Native Language Specialist - German (Switzerland) - Remote
description:
About The Opportunity

We are building a rigorous, verifiable evaluation suite of Terminal-Bench tasks designed to test the limits of large language models on multilingual software challenges. Our goal is to measure multilingual robustness across prompt language effects, non-English data processing, and complex locale/encoding edge cases in terminal workflows.

We are seeking experienced native-speaking software engineers to design, build, and validate these benchmarks. You will create high-signal, high-quality tasks that genuinely test a model's ability to handle multilingual environments without relying on English translation crutches.

Note this is a remote, freelance opportunity

What You’ll Deliver

  • Task Engineering: Evaluating Coding Agents.

  • Asset Creation: Build realistic task environments using datasets and files in your native language. Crucially, these assets must remain in the target language to genuinely measure multilingual handling.

  • Prompting & Translation: finding failure points where AI does not work, in your native language

  • Implementation & Verification: Support the development of robust solutions (reference implementations) and write highly reliable, deterministic verifier scripts (using rubric-based judging only when strictly necessary).

  • Calibration & Execution: Analyze execution logs and calibrate task difficulty (Easy to Very Hard) using standard Terminal-Bench run configurations against various model tiers (Haiku, Sonnet, Opus).

  • Quality Assurance: Participate in a rigorous, 4-layer human quality control process (creation, human review, calibration review, and audit) alongside automated LLM-based checks to ensure fairness, grammatical accuracy, and benchmark integrity.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 1+ years of industry experience in software or prompt engineering.

  • Background: Proven track record at leading technology companies and/or graduation from top-tier engineering universities.

  • Language: Native or near-native fluency, with a deep understanding of its grammar, register, and phrasing rules. High English proficiency.

  • Technical Stack: Strong proficiency in Python, standard shell scripting, and data processing.

  • Workflow: Extensive experience with Terminal/CLI-based development workflows and a working familiarity with coding agents.

  • Domain Expertise: Deep technical understanding of multilingual text processing pitfalls, including:

    • Encoding/decoding robustness and Unicode normalization.

    • Locale-dependent conventions (collation, casing, non-Gregorian dates).

title: Stage Artificial Intelligence & Data Science
description:
Wil jij ervaren hoe het is om AI niet alleen technisch te begrijpen, maar ook écht werkend te maken binnen een organisatie? Heb jij interesse in AI, data, technologie én consultancy? Dan is deze stage binnen ons Data & AI-team misschien wel jouw volgende stap!

Vanaf februari 2027 zoeken wij een stagiair(e) Artificial Intelligence (AI) & Data Science die gedurende 3 tot 12 maanden meewerkt aan interne AI-initiatieven binnen IG&H. Met deze stage krijg je de kans om jouw technische vaardigheden te combineren met consultancyvaardigheden: van het bouwen of onderzoeken van AI-oplossingen tot het ophalen van behoeften bij stakeholders en het ondersteunen van AI-adoptie binnen onze organisatie.

Wat ga je doen?

Tijdens deze leerzame stage ga je aan de slag met interne AI-oplossingen en innovatieprojecten. Afhankelijk van de behoefte vanuit de business werk je zelfstandig aan projecten binnen het team. Je kunt bijvoorbeeld bijdragen aan:

  • het ontwikkelen of verbeteren van AI-tools die interne processen efficiënter maken;

  • het in kaart brengen van processen binnen interne teams en onderzoeken waar AI kan helpen/ondersteunen;

  • het ondersteunen van AI-adoptie binnen IG&H, bijvoorbeeld door mee te denken over trainingen, communicatie of praktische toepassingen van tools zoals Copilot;

  • het doen van onderzoek naar nieuwe AI-producten, toepassingen of proposities;

  • het vertalen van technische mogelijkheden naar concrete businesswaarde;

  • samenwerken met andere collega’s binnen Data & AI.

Over het team

Wij helpen onze klanten innoveren en gebruikmaken van de nieuwste data- en AI-technologie. Ons Data & AI-team bestaat uit ruim 40 data-experts, waaronder Data Scientists, Data Engineers en Consultants. Samen realiseren zij innovatieve data-, analytics- en AI-oplossingen voor klanten in Retail, Financial Services en Health. Het team groeit snel en heeft de ambitie om verder uit te bouwen tot een van de meest toonaangevende Data & AI-praktijken van Nederland. Die groei komt voort uit ons succes: klanten kiezen steeds vaker voor IG&H vanwege onze combinatie van strategisch inzicht, technische expertise en pragmatische executie. We werken aan projecten die direct bijdragen aan betere besluitvorming, efficiëntere processen en nieuwe businessmodellen. Voor professionals die impact willen maken is dit een omgeving waar ondernemerschap, innovatie en persoonlijke ontwikkeling centraal staan. Hier bouw je niet alleen mee aan de toekomst van onze klanten, maar ook aan de verdere groei van het Data & AI-team zelf.

Wat wij verwachten van jou:

We zoeken een leergierig en analytisch sterk persoon die energie krijgt van AI, data science en consultancy. Je vindt het leuk om technologie te begrijpen, maar minstens zo belangrijk: je wilt ontdekken hoe je technologie toepasbaar maakt voor mensen en organisaties. Je brengt mee:

  • Je volgt bij voorkeur een masteropleiding in de richting van Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Computer Science, Econometrie, Natuurkunde, Wiskunde, Engineering of een vergelijkbare technische/kwantitatieve studie;

  • Je hebt ervaring met Python;

  • Je vindt het leuk om met stakeholders in gesprek te gaan en behoeften goed uit te vragen;

  • Je kunt technische onderwerpen helder uitleggen aan mensen met verschillende achtergronden;

  • Je bent sociaal, nieuwsgierig en proactief;

  • Je spreekt en schrijft goed Nederlands en Engels;

  • Je bent vanaf februari 2027 beschikbaar voor 32 tot 40 uur per week.

Ervaring met SQL, API’s, Azure of AI-tools zoals Copilot is mooi meegenomen, maar geen harde eis. Belangrijker vinden we dat je nieuwsgierig bent, snel leert en zin hebt om jezelf inhoudelijk te ontwikkelen.

Wat wij jou bieden:

Bij IG&H krijg je de kans om in korte tijd veel te leren binnen een ambitieus en betrokken Data & AI-team. Je werkt aan een eigen project, krijgt goede begeleiding en maakt kennis met de praktijk van consultancy en technologie. Verder bieden wij jou:

  • Een stage binnen een Great Place to Work met een prettige sfeer en enthousiaste collega’s;

  • De kans om mee te werken aan concrete AI-initiatieven binnen IG&H;

  • Je werkt samen met ervaren collega’s binnen het Data & AI-team;

  • Begeleiding door een buddy en mentor vanuit de organisatie;

  • Veel ruimte om jouw technische én consultancyvaardigheden te ontwikkelen;

  • Een inspirerend kantoor in Utrecht;

  • De mogelijkheid om na enige tijd in overleg deels thuis te werken;

  • Teamactiviteiten, borrels en een open, ondernemende werksfeer;

  • Een contract van 3 tot 12 maanden en een vergoeding tussen de € 700 en € 900,- bruto per maand.

Waarom IG&H?

Met meer dan 650 getalenteerde collega’s hebben we een unieke cultuur gecreëerd die zowel high caring als high daring is. We dagen elkaar uit om grenzen te verleggen, maar doen dat altijd vanuit vertrouwen, samenwerking en plezier.

Als deze stage bij je past, dan is IG&H een mooie plek om je verder te ontwikkelen. Je krijgt de kans om veel te leren in korte tijd, je eigen ideeën in te brengen en te ontdekken hoe het is om te werken binnen een consultancy- en technologieorganisatie waar AI volop in beweging is. Je werkt direct mee aan onderwerpen die relevant zijn voor de toekomst van IG&H en onze klanten.

Ben jij enthousiast geworden over deze stage binnen ons Data & AI-team?

Dan maken we graag kennis met je. Voor meer informatie kun je contact opnemen met ons recruitmentteam via

We willen dat onze medewerkers een afspiegeling zijn van de diversiteit in de samenleving. We werken samen met een opmerkelijke mix van talenten, persoonlijkheden en culturen. IG&H is trots een werkgever te zijn die gelijke kansen biedt. Alle gekwalificeerde sollicitanten worden in overweging genomen voor een stage of dienstverband, ongeacht nationaliteit, ras, religie, geslacht, genderidentiteit of -expressie, seksuele geaardheid, genetica, handicap of leeftijd. We geven om individualiteit, maar het belangrijkste is dat we trots zijn op onze collectieve prestaties en een Great Place to Work.

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld. We werken met preferred suppliers. Stuur ons geen ongevraagde cv’s.

title: Cloud Engineer Automation
description:
Working for a company like Smile Digital Health means supporting our mandate for #BetterGlobalHealth. We strive towards this goal every day, and the results can be seen in the impact of our innovative health data platform and data management solutions, which are used in over 20 countries. We were #19 on Deloitte's Technology Fast 50 Ranking for 2024! 

 

Smile Digital Health makes it easy for healthcare stakeholders to collect and exchange data with our leading FHIR-based data liberation platform.

 

At its heart, the Smile platform enables people and organizations to better manage healthcare data. We help generate and liberate structured healthcare data to ensure effective delivery across care teams and health systems bringing  #BetterGlobalHealth to patients everyday!


Apply today and find plenty of reasons to SMILE!


The Cloud Engineer (Automation) is responsible for designing, building, operating and improving production-grade automation for Smile Digital Health, its clients and partners. This role will be responsible for the pipelines, infrastructure as code, environments and recovery procedures, that the platform runs on. 

This Engineer will merge direct platform engineering expertise with driving strategic changes in how the department designs, deploys, and maintains its infrastructure. Key responsibilities include managing build and release engineering, orchestrating the Terraform and Helm infrastructure, provisioning on-demand environments, and implementing automated recovery. This role works closely with Platform Engineering, Solution Engineering, Service Operations and Engineering Practice & QA to remove unnecessary repetitive, manual work and effectively optimize a build from the time the client commits to a running environment faster, decrease platform costs, and utilize AI to enhance the platformâs engineering and operations.

\n


Responsibilities:
  • Own build and release engineering by reviewing the current repositories and CI setup, then consolidate duplicated Azure DevOps pipeline YAML onto shared reusable templates with change detection and automated quality gates.
  • Identify and eliminate manual efforts for cross-functional teams and replace them with scheduled, auditable automation. For example, automating patching, certificate and secret rotation, environment scaling, and recurring reports
  • Implement GitOps-based continuous delivery - declarative, Git-driven deployments with automated reconciliation, drift detection and rollback.
  • Automate line-of-business environments end to end, provisioned and torn down on demand across every Azure service and application involved.
  • Automate business continuity and disaster recovery through backup validation, restore and failover, recurring DR drills, and measured RTO and RPO.
  • Ensure Helm and Terraform are easy to upgrade by charting reuse and configuration validation, versioned modules, and state boundaries that limit how far an upgrade reaches.
  • Run in-cluster platform services deployed through Helm, harden workloads for availability and capacity: health probes, replica counts, and right-sized requests, limits and autoscaling.
  • Ensure that the Terraform configuration is regularly maintained.
  • Build and maintain Build Agent images for streamlining tooling available for the builds. 
  • Automate the guardrails such as policy-as-code, security and IaC scanning in the pipeline, and alerts and dashboards defined as code.
  • Implement AI-assisted engineering in the platform teamâs day-to-day work
  • Contribute to the departmentâs AI enablement, package knowledge into reusable skills and runbooks in the shared skill library.
  • Work with the development and operations teams to find automation gaps, prioritize them, and close them.
  • Troubleshoot production and staging issues and document what you automate so others can operate it.


Requirements:
  • 6+ years of hands-on cloud engineering, DevOps and/or platform engineering experience, including at least 1-2+ years with infrastructure as code and CI/CD automation on Microsoft Azure in production.
  • Post-secondary education in Computer Science, Engineering, or similar and/or equivalent work experience. 
  • Practical in-depth knowledge and expertise in Terraform, Helm and Azure DevOps pipelines, and GitOps delivery (Argo CD or Flux). 
  • Strong Terraform skills including, but not limited to, experience with module design, provider version management, state management and refactoring.
  • Expertise in Helm chart authoring and refactoring, including recent experience with Kubernetes and AKS.
  • Demonstrated knowledge across Azure (AKS, Key Vault, Storage, Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, networking, identity) and observability as code (Azure Monitor and/or Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry).
  • Hands-on experience automating backup, restore and failover with measured RTO and RPO.
  • Hands-on experience with agentic coding tools (Claude Code or equivalent), keeping confidential data out of them and reviewing what they produce.
  • Hands-on experience running, hardening and right-sizing production workloads on Kubernetes
  • Hands-on Kafka operations: topic and partition design, consumer group sizing, and throughput and latency trade-offs. Experience migrating between Kafka platforms (HDInsight, Confluent, MSK or self-managed) is a strong asset.
  • Strong Python and Bash skills, able to build maintainable tooling, not glue scripts.
  • A demonstrable record of replacing manual processes with automation.
  • FinOps practice and Azure Cost Management, an asset. 
  • Regulated environment experience (healthcare, PHI), an asset. 
  • Certifications: HashiCorp Terraform Associate; Microsoft AZ-104, AZ-400, AZ-305; CKA or CKAD, an asset. 
  • Observability as code with Azure Monitor, Grafana, Prometheus, or OpenTelemetry; Azure cost optimization, an asset. 


\n
$120,000 - $140,000 a year
\n

Smile discloses that artificial intelligence (AI) may be used in portions of the recruitment and selection process, such as resume screening or application assessment. All hiring decisions are ultimately made by qualified human decision-makers, and AI tools are used to support â not replace â fair and equitable hiring practices. 

 

This position is a new role, created to support Smileâs continued growth and commitment to operational excellence.

About AMBOSS

We are a medical education and clinical support platform dedicated to empowering healthcare professionals worldwide to deliver the best possible care.

Founded in Germany, AMBOSS has grown to over 600 team members, with offices in Berlin, Cologne, New York, and Cagliari. Since entering the U.S. medical education market in 2017 with resources for USMLE and shelf exam preparation, AMBOSS has expanded to include point-of-care clinical support and board preparation across multiple specialties. We are now developing a new Qbank for the ABOG Qualifying Examination and are looking for OB-GYN residents and recent residency graduates to help shape this resource.

Position Summary

We are seeking PGY-4 OB-GYN residents or recent graduates for a remote, part-time freelance role developing a new ABOG Qualifying Examination Qbank. You will use your clinical training and board preparation experience to help identify high-yield topics, define what makes a high-quality board-style question, and review questions for exam relevance, difficulty, and educational value. You may also have opportunities to share your insights with multidisciplinary teams (e.g., Commercial, Marketing, AI, Product, and User Research) to help improve medical education and support the responsible use of AI. This role offers a flexible opportunity to explore meaningful nonclinical work alongside your clinical training or practice.

Responsibilities Include

  • Identifying high-yield ABOG exam topics and gaps in Qbank question coverage

  • Helping define what makes a high-quality board-style question

  • Reviewing questions to assess how well they match the ABOG exam in format, content, and difficulty

  • Evaluating whether questions and explanations are clear, concise, and useful for board preparation

  • Suggesting specific changes to improve questions and their educational value

  • Sharing insights from OB-GYN residency training and board preparation with other teams

Qualifications

  • Medical degree (MD/DO).

  • Current PGY-4 resident or recent graduate of an ACGME-accredited OB-GYN residency program in the U.S.

  • Familiarity with the ABOG Qualifying Examination and OB-GYN board preparation resources

  • Strong clinical reasoning, attention to detail, and written communication skills

  • Ability to provide clear, practical feedback focused on educational value

  • Comfortable working independently and meeting agreed-upon deadlines in an asynchronous remote environment

  • Preferred (not required): Experience with AI and/or LLM applications

Logistics

  • Position type: Freelance, independent contractor (project-based)

  • Location: Fully remote

  • Duration: 3 months (~5â10 hours/week, as needed)

  • Schedule: Flexible and project-based, with agreed-upon turnaround times

  • Compensation: $75-$100/hr for current residents; $100-120/hr for recent graduates and attendings

  • Start date: As soon as possible

Why join us?

  • Use your medical training and board preparation experience to help shape the future of residency education and board preparation.

  • Contribute to the quality and responsible use of AI-powered medical education.

  • Explore meaningful nonclinical work that complements your clinical training or practice, with flexible, fully remote part-time hours.

We believe that diversity is a powerful driver of innovation and progress. Thatâs why we are committed to fostering an inclusive, respectful, and supportive environment where everyoneâregardless of gender, age, ethnic or cultural background, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender identityâis valued and given equal opportunity to thrive. We warmly welcome people of all backgrounds to help us fulfil our mission: empowering all medical professionals to provide the best possible care!

title: Solutions Engineer
description:
Consequential Work. Dedicated People.


About Onebrief

Onebrief builds collaboration and AI-powered workflow software for military planning and operational coordination.

Military planning is complex by nature, requiring teams to coordinate information, people, and decisions across systems and locations. Onebrief brings planning, collaboration, simulation, and AI into one connected environment, helping teams test strategies, adapt to changing conditions, and make decisions with greater clarity when the stakes are real.

We are a distributed team of builders from military, operational, and technology backgrounds who care deeply about improving how important work gets done. Some team members work remotely, while others work directly alongside customers in operational environments around the world.

Founded in 2019, Onebrief is backed by leading investors including General Catalyst, Battery Ventures, Insight Partners, Sapphire Ventures, and Human Capital. Valued at more than $2 billion, we continue to invest in product innovation, AI capabilities, and team growth.

Why This Role Exists

As a Solutions Engineer at Onebrief, you work where mission, engineering, and compliance meet.

You'll own technical solution design and deployment readiness, translating customer requirements into secure, scalable deployment architectures. You'll partner with Platform Engineering, SRE, and our Cybersecurity team to validate infrastructure, configure environments, resolve technical blockers, and successfully transition solutions into production.

Youâll work with our go-to-market and customer facing teams to meet with planners, operations officers, and network owners to understand how they work today. Youâll help show them what that work looks like in Onebrief, and then you'll make it real.

You connect a staff's planning problem to a live, accredited Onebrief deployment.

What You'll Do

Core responsibilities:

  • Run technical discovery. With Sales and Engineering, map a staff's current workflow and pain points, specifically focusing on their technical constraints: networks, hosting, identity, and integration requirements, especially in multi-network environments.

  • Lead deployment engineering. Coordinate the technical delivery of new deployments, including infrastructure validation, network configuration checks, and system readiness verification. Write code to configure new deployments and support new environments.

  • Support accreditation. Help create and review security documentation, including STIG checklists and ATO artifacts, alongside our cybersecurity team so deployments are accredited on the customer's timeline.

  • Align stakeholders. Get technical stakeholders on both sides to agree on requirements, constraints, and tradeoffs, so customers see value sooner. Ensure those technical requirements are properly translated into contract deliverables.

  • Scope integrations. Design how Onebrief Connect fits into a command's ecosystem: APIs, data pipelines, Foundry and Maven Smart System, CUOPS tools, and dashboards.

  • Deliver tailored demos. Lead technical demonstrations and solution validation, partnering with Sales and customer-facing teams to demonstrate Onebrief's technical capabilities, deployment architecture, security posture, and integration options.

  • Run pilot deployments. Configure Onebrief in new and untested environments to enable limited uses in support of new sales.

  • Turn field experience into patterns. Convert what you learn in deployments into structured workflows and reusable implementation patterns, and feed clear requirements to Product and Engineering.

  • Travel 30â50% of the time to customer sites and exercises.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility.

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • 4+ years in solutions engineering, infrastructure or deployment engineering, or forward-deployed engineering, working closely with go-to-market and operational teams

  • Experience in DoW environments and their security and compliance requirements (RMF, STIGs, ICD 503)

  • Strong expertise with containers (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes)

  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and on-premises virtualization (RHEL)

  • Solid understanding of networking concepts and protocols, and of security best practices for highly sensitive environments

  • Strong presence with customers, from action officers to senior leaders, and clear, concise writing

  • Calm under pressure, and focused on forward motion

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficiency in a scripting language (Python, Go, or Bash)

  • Infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible)

  • Monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog) and service mesh (Istio, Linkerd)

  • Experience as a military planner or staff officer, or with mission command systems, Foundry, or Maven Smart System

  • Presales experience, including building and delivering demos

In the event a recruiter or agency submits a resume or candidate without an agreement Onebrief explicitly reserves the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. title: Revenue Operations Analyst (m/w/d)
description:
Über Cosuno

Cosuno digitalisiert die Beschaffung in der Baubranche, einer der größten und zugleich am wenigsten digitalisierten Branchen weltweit. Als Berliner Startup unterstützen wir Bauunternehmen dabei, ihre Beschaffungsprozesse effizienter zu gestalten. Unser Team ist ambitioniert und verfolgt ein gemeinsames Ziel: die digitale Transformation der Baubranche voranzutreiben.

Deine Rolle

Als Revenue Operations Analyst entwickelst du dich Schritt für Schritt zum Architekten unseres Go-to-Market-Setups. Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Leadership Team zusammen und trägst maßgeblich dazu bei, unsere kommerzielle Effizienz weiter zu steigern. Dabei verwaltest du Prozesse nicht nur, sondern optimierst sie gezielt mithilfe moderner KI-Technologien und datengetriebener Analysen.

  • Prozessoptimierung & Skalierung: Du analysierst unsere Sales-Prozesse End-to-End, identifizierst Engpässe und automatisierst Workflows.

  • Reporting & Forecasting: Du verantwortest Teile unseres Reportings und Forecastings und lieferst datenbasierte Insights für die Entscheidungen des Leadership Teams.

  • KI-Automatisierung: Du evaluierst neue KI-Tools und überführst manuelle Prozesse in automatisierte, intelligente Abläufe.

  • Full Project Ownership: Du verantwortest eigene Projekte von der Konzeption bis zum Go-live und arbeitest dabei eng mit Sales, Customer Success und Finance zusammen.

  • Tool-Stack: Du arbeitest mit Salesforce, Salesloft, Avoma, Chargebee und BigQuery.

Projektbeispiele

Beispiele für Projekte, die unser RevOps-Team zuletzt umgesetzt hat:

  • Automatisierung der Kundendatenpflege: Konzeption, Umsetzung und unternehmensweite Einführung einer KI-gestützten Lösung, die Kontaktdaten aus eingehender E-Mail-Korrespondenz automatisch erfasst und im CRM-System aktualisiert, einschließlich Erfolgsmessung und laufender Überwachung

  • KI-gestütztes Forderungsmanagement: Auswahl, Aufbau und Optimierung eines KI-Telefonassistenten für automatisierte Zahlungserinnerungen sowie Wirtschaftlichkeitsanalyse im Vergleich zur manuellen Bearbeitung

  • Automatisierung von Recruiting-Prozessen: Erstellung standardisierter Kommunikationsvorlagen für Bewerbungsprozesse und Mitarbeit an einem einheitlichen Bewertungssystem für Vorstellungsgespräche

  • Vertriebsreporting: Pflege und Weiterentwicklung von Reports und Kennzahlenübersichten für Vertrieb und Management sowie Erstellung eines Leitfadens für neue Mitarbeitende

Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung: Du hast dein Studium erfolgreich abgeschlossen und erste Praxiserfahrung gesammelt, idealerweise in einem Startup, SaaS-Unternehmen oder in der Beratung.

  • KI-Affinität: Du bist Early Adopter neuer KI-Tools und setzt sie souverän im Arbeitsalltag ein.

  • Analytische Denkweise: Du übersetzt Daten in klare Handlungsempfehlungen und hinterfragst Zahlen kritisch.

  • Lösungsorientierung: Du gehst Herausforderungen eigenständig und strukturiert an.

  • Excel-Kenntnisse: Du verfügst über sehr gute Kenntnisse in Excel oder Google Sheets.

  • Growth Mindset: Du möchtest dich in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen weiterentwickeln und langfristig Verantwortung übernehmen.

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch.

title: Junior Software Developer
description:
The Software Developer I, Connector role supports Trial Interactive’s proprietary platform, Connector - the cloud-based integrations that move life science data between clients’ clinical systems (for example EDC/eCRF and IRT systems) and Trial Interactive’s life science products. Working under the guidance of senior engineers, the role helps build and maintain connectors, keeps client data flowing accurately, and resolves issues when it does not.

This is a blended role, covering development and maintenance up until handling client requests. This role works closely with the Solutions, DevOps and Engineering teams.

DESCRIPTION

As part of the Development and maintenance responsibility, the resource handles:

• Develop, test and maintain connector components in C# on .NET (AWS Lambda), including the parsers and mappers that convert source-system data (API payloads, files) into the formats required by the Trial Interactive CTMS and eTMF.

• Configure and extend mappings for new studies, sites and visit/status definitions on existing connectors, reusing existing modules wherever possible.

• Assist in the technical onboarding of new clients and studies: connector configuration, test runs in non-production environments, and verification before go-live.

• Work with the AWS services connectors are built on (Lambda, SQS, S3, EventBridge/Step Functions, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch) and make small, reviewed infrastructure changes using Terraform under supervision.

• Consume, test and troubleshoot REST APIs (client/vendor APIs and Trial Interactive import APIs) using code and tools such as Postman, and help extend APIs that improve connector stability and connectivity.

• Write unit and functional tests; use Git (feature branches, merge requests, environment branches) and follow the team’s code review and release process.

• Keep code, configuration and change records documented so that others can maintain them.

• Work on special projects, such as local test environments using LocalStack.

As part of handling Client communication, support and ticket resolution, the resource does:

• Own assigned support tickets from triage to closure: reproduce the issue, investigate, fix or escalate, and record the outcome in the ticketing system (for example Jira, ServiceDesk Plus).

• Investigate data issues end to end – trace a record from the source payload through the archive, parser, connector database and logs to its CTMS/eTMF import result – and establish the root cause (RCA) with evidence.

• Reconcile source-system data against the CTMS/eTMF when a client reports missing or mismatched subjects, visits or statuses, and explain any differences.

• Communicate with clients and Solutions Engineers by email, tickets and calls: acknowledge requests promptly, ask clear clarifying questions, give regular status updates, and explain findings and next steps in plain language.

• Monitor connector health (CloudWatch logs, failed imports, notifications) and respond to failures within agreed response times.

• Escalate appropriately to senior engineers, DevOps or the vendor, with a concise summary of what happened, when, in which environment and for which records.

• Write up RCAs, fixes and known issues so that repeat problems are resolved faster, and help keep support documentation current.

• Handle client and clinical data with care: use the minimum data needed, never share one client’s information with another, and follow Trial Interactive data-protection and change-control procedures.

General

• Keep learning the connector platform, the clinical-trial data domain and cloud and software development best practices.

• Complete all other tasks that are deemed appropriate for this role and assigned by the manager/supervisor.


REQUIRED SKILLS

• Clear written and spoken English, with the ability to explain technical issues in plain language to non-technical clients and to write concise ticket updates and emails.

• A client-service mindset: responsive, calm under pressure, and takes ownership of a ticket until it is resolved or properly handed over.

• Strong problem-solving and debugging skills: forms a hypothesis, checks logs and data, and proves the root cause with evidence before concluding.

• Strong attention to detail with data, such as identifiers, dates, time zones and character encodings.

• Good time management: balances planned development work with interrupt-driven support, prioritizing by client impact.

• Works collaboratively within a team, asks for help early, and is self-motivated and eager to learn.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor’s degree or its equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

• 0–1 years of experience in software development, technical support or cloud-based application support; internships and substantial academic or personal projects count.

• Working knowledge of C# and the .NET framework: able to read and debug existing code and deliver small features.

• Familiarity with AWS, particularly Lambda, S3, SQS and CloudWatch Logs.

• Working SQL skills (joins, filtering, aggregation) on relational databases, preferably MySQL.

• Understanding of REST APIs and of JSON, XML and CSV data; experience calling APIs with Postman or similar tools.

• Understanding of data parsing and mapping techniques, including handling of dates, null values and encodings.

• Experience or familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git).

DESIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

• Experience with LocalStack for local AWS cloud application development.

• Familiarity with Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code tools.

• Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation.

• Prior experience in customer-facing support, or with ticketing tools such as Jira or ServiceDesk Plus.

• Exposure to clinical research systems and concepts (EDC, CTMS, eTMF; study, site, subject, visit) or to regulated (GxP) software environments.

• Scripting (Python or shell) for data checks and log analysis.

• Familiarity with containerization and microservices architecture.

title: Software Test Engineer 80–100%
description:
About machineMD

At machineMD in Bern we’re on a mission to radically improve the measurement of brain function through standardized, automated, quantitative exams. Our signature product, neos™, is the world’s first non-invasive neuro-ophthalmoscope for fast, automated assessment of eye movements and pupils. Founded at the University Hospital of Bern, Switzerland, we’ve grown into a startup of 25 engineers, clinicians, scientists, and specialists working side by side. We aim to bring the diagnostic quality of highly trained specialists into secondary and primary care settings everywhere.

We’re building neurodiagnostics for the next generation with our neos™ device and oculometrics software. As our Software Test Engineer, you’ll have room to make a visible difference in how we test. Find a gap, develop an approach, and put it to work, whether that means automating a manual check, building better test data, or connecting tests across the system. You’ll develop our test automation with support from developers, requirements engineers, and testers. Our existing test infrastructure gives you a starting point, with room to introduce your own ideas and additional tools as you connect and improve how we test.

The Role

You’ll help us understand how neos™ behaves when its components work together—and where they fail. Your main contribution will be developing automated tests, test data, and scripts that make complex scenarios repeatable and problems easier to diagnose. You’ll work alongside developers and use the domain expertise and manual testing provided by requirements engineers and testers.

  • Pragmatic Improvements – assess our current testing setup with the team, identify the biggest weaknesses, and tackle them step by step. Build on what works, try useful approaches, and let a broader test concept grow from the improvements you put into practice.

  • Automation Across the System – develop automated tests for complex, distributed systems across different frameworks and technologies, covering multiple components, interfaces, and end-to-end scenarios beyond UI testing.

  • Test Infrastructure – build on and improve our physical and software-based test environments. Introduce tools and setups where they make testing more effective, and keep them documented so tests remain repeatable and usable by others.

  • Coordination & Code Quality – work hands-on with developers to implement automation, coordinate contributions, and review the quality of test code. Connect individual improvements so our testing becomes more consistent and easier to extend over time.

  • Verification & Validation – contribute to V&V plans, protocols, reports, and evidence, and coordinate activities with the relevant specialists. Help keep testing, requirements, and documentation aligned in a medical device environment.

What We Look For

Experience

  • Solid practical experience in software engineering, including designing, implementing, debugging, and maintaining software. You can understand existing codebases and develop clear, well-structured solutions that others can maintain and extend.

  • Experience with some of our core technologies (Python, C#/.NET, C++ and Flutter/Dart) is a plus. Python and pytest are particularly useful for test automation, and you’re willing to learn the technologies needed for the task.

  • Practical experience developing automated tests across different system levels, with the programming skills to implement, understand, and review test code.

  • Experience with verification and validation of medical devices or familiarity with ISO 13485 is a plus.

Qualifications

  • Solid software testing fundamentals at ISTQB Foundation Level or equivalent knowledge, including test planning, test design, and requirements coverage.

  • Vocational training or a higher degree in computer science, software engineering, medical informatics, or a related technical field.

  • Fluent English (minimum strong B2, ideally C1); German or French language skills are a plus for on-site collaboration.

How You Work

  • Systems Thinker – you want to understand how neos™ works as a whole, from its software and hardware to the tests and data behind it. you choose practical improvements as our product and testing continue to develop.

  • Curiosity & a Detective’s Instinct – you notice when something doesn’t quite add up and enjoy following the clues. You question assumptions, explore unusual scenarios, and keep digging until you can explain and reproduce what you’ve found.

  • Close the Gaps – you enjoy getting your hands dirty and following a problem across disciplines. When progress depends on something outside your usual remit, you’re willing to learn, lend a hand.

  • Collaborative Spirit – you work closely with colleagues, share what you know and what you’re unsure about, and address difficult topics openly. You listen with curiosity, give and receive candid feedback, and make room for different perspectives.

  • Shaper Mentality & Growth Mindset – you want to shape how testing works, take responsibility, and build missing skills quickly. You’re curious about neurodiagnostics and ready to learn from experts and real-world use cases.

Working at machineMD

  • Based in Bern, Switzerland, with roughly 80% of your working time on-site (approximately four days a week at full-time employment) and Monday as our shared anchor day.

  • Collaborative, in-person working, with flexibility to do your best work.

Our Four Pillars of Integrity guide how we work together:

  • Radical Responsibility: Own our choices.

  • Feeling Our Feelings: Name and honour our emotions.

  • Candor: Speak and listen with honesty.

  • Clear Agreements: Make and keep clear commitments.

Life’s too short to work on boring stuff. If you want to connect ideas, people, and technology to advance brain diagnostics in a dynamic startup, let’s talk!

How to Apply

Send your CV and a short note about a project or task from your career that you enjoyed a lot, and explain why.

We welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of gender, age, background, or orientation. Direct applications only, no recruiters please.

We’re excited to meet you!

title: Information Security Administrator
description:
Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking an experienced Security Administrator with a primary focus on security administration, audit support, policy management, and third-party risk oversight to maintain a continuous compliance posture against NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5, HIPAA, and related frameworks.

The ideal candidate will be a self-starter with strong project management skills, audit experience, and the ability to manage multiple security and compliance workstreams while supporting security leadership, privacy stakeholders, vendors, on-site security engineering teams, and independent assessment organizations.

This selected individual will support our SafeGuard Services (SGS) team, a subsidiary of Peraton, which performs data analysis, investigation, and medical review, to detect, prevent, deter, reduce, and make referrals to recover fraud, waste, and abuse in Medicare/Medicaid healthcare programs.

What you'll do:

The Security Administrator will be responsible for the following but not limited to::

Security Compliance & Policy Management

  • Author, maintain, and update security policies, procedures, standards, plans, and control documentation for the SGS Contracts environment.
  • Perform control testing and gap analysis against NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5, HIPAA/HITECH and the CMS ARS and PIM.

Program & Administrative Support
